title: Agent frameworks and orchestrators

atom_notes.A16: an orchestrator is a model deciding what to do next, so the manipulation surface is the plan
atom_notes.A02: handoffs transfer authority between agents, and that is a trust boundary
atom_notes.A08: evidence and memory are what an orchestrator carries forward, and where a finding can silently change

entries.name: PentestGPT
entries.role: The original reasoning-first pentest agent. Plans and reasons, delegates execution to tools
preconditions: a target and an AI key
oracle: plan plus tool calls that a human can follow
entries.note: Its contribution was the reasoning loop, not the tools. Read it as a design reference.
entries.mirror_note: no mirror row covers this entry

entries.name: Cybersecurity AI (CAI)
entries.role: Framework for building security agents with roles, tools and handoffs
oracle: agent role output with tool trace
entries.note: The role and handoff primitives are what a critic pattern needs.
entries.mirror_note: no mirror row covers this entry

entries.name: PentAGI
entries.role: Multi agent pentest system with a sandboxed execution layer and persistent memory

tree.q: Do you need one agent or several?
tree.why: Most campaigns need one executor and one critic. Adding agents multiplies requests and detection, not findings.
